title: sdks: improve auth/retries/streaming ergonomics and bump parity to v1.86.0
author: Ava Martinez
description:
Motivation: unify SDK ergonomics across Python/TypeScript/Go for auth handling, retry defaults, and streaming APIs to reduce customer confusion and eliminate subtle parity bugs. This PR combines changes requested in ENG-4521 and several follow-ups from recent bug reports (SUP-1023).

Summary of changes: consolidated auth config shape across SDKs, introduced a unified RetryPolicy interface with sane defaults and clear extensibility, improved streaming consumer ergonomics (async iterator for Python, event-emitter-style TS API, context-aware cancellation for Go), and fixed several small parity issues (parameter names, error wrapping, metadata propagation). Version bumps for sdk packages to v1.86.0.

Compatibility and migration notes: all changes are backward-compatible by default. Deprecated legacy auth env var (REDWOOD_API_KEY_LEGACY) is still supported but will be removed in v1.90.0 (deprecation warning added). Retry behavior defaults changed to be slightly more conservative (fewer retries for idempotent vs non-idempotent calls) — teams relying on previous retry counts can opt out by passing a RetryPolicy. Streaming API surface additions are additive; existing user code will continue to work.

Checklist: - [x] Python SDK: unify auth constructor and add async iterator for streaming responses - [x] TypeScript SDK: add EventEmitter streaming helper and better types for auth/retries - [x] Go SDK: context-aware streaming, improved backpressure signaling, and retry wrapper - [x] Tests added for cross-language parity and end-to-end auth scenarios - [x] Docs updated with migration notes and examples

Reasoning: Multiple customers reported confusion across SDKs when switching languages and inconsistent retry/streaming behavior caused production incidents (see SUP-1023 incident notes). By aligning these core primitives we reduce cognitive load for engineers and lower the chance of cross-language regressions.

Next steps: monitor metrics for SDK usage and flaky retries, follow-up deprecation PR to remove legacy env var, plan a minor release with changelog and upgrade guide.

release_notes:
Release v1.86.0: SDK parity and ergonomics improvements across Python/TypeScript/Go.
- Unified auth configuration and clearer migration path (REDWOOD_API_KEY_LEGACY deprecated).
- Introduced shared RetryPolicy with conservative defaults and per-call opt-out.
- Streaming ergonomics: Python async iterator, TypeScript StreamingEmitter, Go context-aware streaming + backpressure signals.
- Fixes for parameter parity and metadata propagation across SDKs.
See docs/sdk-migration/auth-retries-streaming.md for migration examples and code samples.
notes: Observed a transient typescript streaming test flake in CI; deterministic test harness fixes were applied. Post-merge: will watch SDK telemetry for unexpected increases in auth failures or changed retry behavior. Deprecation notice will be communicated in the next SDK blog and via in-console notices.
